# ANALYSIS: SNIPER_STAGE2_GRINDER_TOP_KEEPER

**Filed:** 2026-07-22  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** analysis  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The top keeper from sniper_stage2_grinder (vol_mult=1.1, body_min_cents=0.02, min_stars=2, strike_offset=2, premium_stop_pct=-0.06, tp1_premium_pct=0.4, runner_target_pct=3.0, profit_lock_threshold_pct=0.0, profit_lock_stop_offset_pct=0.08, tp1_qty_fraction=0.667, qty=10, proximity_dollars=1.5, require_break_above_open=true) achieves a wide_pnl of 40656.65 over 234 trades with a win rate of 93.2%. However, its edge_capture on J's source-of-truth days is only 373.48, which is below the OP-16 rejection floor of 771 (50% of max possible 1542). The engine takes all three winner days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04) and avoids losses on all loser days (5/05, 5/06, 5/07), but the PNL on winner days is substantially lower than the J truth trades (181.84 vs 342 on 4/29, 0 vs 470 on 5/01, 191.64 vs 730 on 5/04), indicating the strategy is not capturing the full potential of the edge.

## Mechanism

Entry triggers on a level break with volume ≥1.1× 20-bar average, minimum candle body of 2 cents, and ≥2 stars (quality filter). Trades OTM-2 puts (strike_offset=2). Exit uses a -6% premium stop, +40% TP1 at 66.7% quantity, runner target of +300% profit, and profit lock disabled (threshold 0.0) with 8% stop offset if armed (though threshold 0.0 implies immediate profit lock arming).
